v: Then he showed me the river of the water of life,[^1] bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον, ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου

down the middle of the city's street. On either side of the river was the tree of life,[^2] bearing twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.[^3]
ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς· καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα, κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν.
There will no longer be any curse.[^4] The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will worship him.[^5]
καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι. καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται, καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ,
They will see his face,[^6] and his name will be on their foreheads.
καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.
There will be no more night. They will need no light of a lamp or light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light,[^7] and they will reign forever and ever.[^8]
καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φῶς ἡλίου, ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς φωτίσει ἐπʼ αὐτούς, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
Then he said to me, "These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.[^9]
Καὶ εἶπέν μοι· Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί, καὶ ὁ κύριος, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει·
And look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this scroll."[^10]
καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ· μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου.
I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed them to me.
Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα. καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα, ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα.
But he said to me, "Don't do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters[^11] the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this scroll. Worship God!"
καὶ λέγει μοι· Ὅρα μή· σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· τῷ θεῷ προσκύνησον.
Then he said to me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this scroll, for the time is near.[^12]
Καὶ λέγει μοι· Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου, ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν.
Let the one who does wrong still do wrong, and the filthy still be filthy; let the righteous still do what is right, and the holy still be holy."[^13]
ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπαρευθήτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι.
"Look, I am coming soon, and my reward is with me,[^14] to repay each person according to what they have done.[^15]
Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ, καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.[^16]
ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος.
Blessed are those who wash their robes,[^17] so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
Μακάριοι οἱ πλύνοντες τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν, ἵνα ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν.
Outside are the dogs,[^18] the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify to you[^19] about these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David,[^20] the bright morning star."[^21]
Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός, ὁ πρωϊνός.
The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let the one who hears say, "Come!" Let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who wishes take the water of life without cost.[^22]
καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω, ὁ θέλων λαβέτω ὕδωρ ζωῆς δωρεάν.
I testify[^23] to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this scroll: if anyone adds to them, God will add to that person the plagues that are written in this scroll.
Μαρτυρῶ ἐγὼ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπʼ αὐτά, ἐπιθήσει ὁ θεὸς ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ·

And if anyone takes away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away that person's share in the tree of life[^24] and in the holy city, which are written about in this scroll.[^25]
καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ταύτης, ἀφελεῖ ὁ θεὸς τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας, τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ.
The one who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus![^26]
Λέγει ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα· Ναί· ἔρχομαι ταχύ. Ἀμήν· ἔρχου, κύριε Ἰησοῦ.
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.[^27]
Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων.

n.1: That is, the angel of 21:9. Many manuscripts read "a pure river of the water of life". Compare Ezekiel 47:1–12, the river that flows out from the temple; Zechariah 14:8, "On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem".
n.3: Or "flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb. In the middle of the city's street, and on either side of the river, was the tree of life …". Compare Ezekiel 47:12, "They will bear fresh fruit every month … Their fruit will be for food and their leaves for healing."
n.4: Compare Zechariah 14:11, "there will never again be a curse of destruction"; Genesis 3:17.
n.5: Greek *latreuo*. See 7:15.
n.6: Compare Psalm 17:15, "in righteousness I will see your face"; contrast Exodus 33:20.
n.7: Compare Isaiah 60:19, "But the LORD will be your everlasting light". See 21:23.
n.8: Compare Daniel 7:18, 27.
n.9: See 1:1. Compare Daniel 2:28–29, 45. *The God of the spirits of the prophets*: compare Numbers 27:16, "the LORD, the God of the spirits of all living beings".
n.10: In verse 7, as in verses 12–16 and 20, the speaker is Jesus.
n.11: Greek *adelphoi*, "brothers", used of the believers, men and women alike.
n.12: Contrast Daniel 8:26; 12:4, 9, where Daniel is told to seal the book until the time of the end.
n.13: Compare Daniel 12:10, "Many will be purified, made white and refined, but the wicked will act wickedly."
n.14: Compare Isaiah 40:10; 62:11, "Look, his reward is with him, and his recompense goes before him."
n.15: Literally "as his work is". Compare Psalm 62:13 (62:12 in most English Bibles); Proverbs 24:12, "He will repay each person according to what he has done."
n.17: Many manuscripts read "Blessed are those who do his commands". See 7:14.
n.18: A term of contempt for people regarded as impure. Compare Deuteronomy 23:19 (23:18 in most English Bibles); Philippians 3:2.
n.20: Literally "the root and the offspring of David". Compare Isaiah 11:1, 10; see 5:5.
n.21: Compare Numbers 24:17, "A star will march out of Jacob". See 2:28.
n.22: Compare Isaiah 55:1, "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters! … without money and without cost." See 21:6.
n.23: The speaker may be Jesus, "the one who testifies to these things" (verse 20), or John. Compare Deuteronomy 4:2, "Do not add anything to what I command you, and do not take anything away from it"; 13:1 (12:32 in most English Bibles).
n.24: The Textus Receptus (followed by the King James Version) reads "the book of life".
n.25: Many manuscripts read "may God add to that person" in verse 18 and "may God take away" here.
n.26: Many manuscripts read "Amen. Yes, come, Lord Jesus!" Compare the Aramaic prayer *marana tha*, "Our Lord, come!" (1 Corinthians 16:22).
n.27: The SBLGNT here follows NA28. Other editions read "be with God's holy people" (literally "the holy ones"), and Westcott and Hort read "the Lord Jesus Christ". Many manuscripts read "The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all God's holy people. Amen."
